name: Shenzhou 17
about: Shenzhou 17 (2023-164A), a crewed vehicle (Shenzhou), launched 2023 Oct 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2023 Oct 26), held fixed
